# Pull Request

## Description
Describe your changes and why they are needed.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / chore

## How Has This Been Tested?
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] `ruff check omni_router/`
- [ ] Manual `curl http://127.0.0.1:8787/health` / `/ui` / `/metrics`

## Checklist
- [ ] No secrets committed (`providers.json`, `*.env` are gitignored)
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` if user-facing
- [ ] Updated `README.md` if needed
